title: Agar Tum Saath Ho
notes: Capo 1, D-family shapes. Sources agree on capo 1 with D/Bm/A/G. Bm can be played as a 4-string mini barre. Play softly; arpeggiate the verse.

title: Phir Le Aaya Dil (Reprise)
techniqueFocus: C to D walk back to G
notes: Arijit Singh reprise version, no capo, open G/Am/C/D. Other versions differ: Shafqat Amanat Ali's is in A, Rekha Bhardwaj's in C. Duration is the soundtrack reprise (~4:45).

title: Iktara
notes: Two sources agree: key G, no capo, G/C/Am/D with a single F in the antara (F can be played as Fmaj7 x33210). Some players note the record may use open-G tuning; standard tuning works fine. BPM approximate.

title: Hawayein
notes: Sources agree on no capo with D, G, A, Em. Strumming varies between sources (DDU UDU vs D UDUD UDUD DU); the simpler one is used. BPM approximate.

title: Saiyaara
strummingPattern: D D U U D U
techniqueFocus: smooth chord changes on the beat
notes: Capo 4 with Em-family shapes (sounds G#m); two sources agree on capo 4 and the Em-D-C-D loop. Bm only appears in the pre-chorus; Cmaj7 can replace C for colour.

title: Tum Se Hi
strummingPattern: D D U U D U
notes: Capo 4 with D shapes is the common version (capo 6 with C shapes also gives the same key). One source lists a no-capo G version, which is a half-step off the record.

title: Raataan Lambiyan
notes: Capo 1 with A/E/D shapes; an alternative is capo 3 with G/C/D shapes (same sounding key). Strumming differs across sources; DDU DD and D DUD are both common.

title: Ilahi
notes: Sources agree: key A, no capo, A with Dsus2/D and E. Only three shapes but the tempo is quick (~132 BPM) - practise slowly first.

title: Kesariya
notes: Key C, no capo, built on Fmaj7-G-C. The full F in the chorus can stay Fmaj7 for beginners. Some sheets offer a capo-2 C/G/Am/F version for singing range.

title: Tujhe Kitna Chahne Lage
notes: Capo 4 with G shapes (original key B). Multiple sources list G/Em/C/D plus Am/Bm with capo 4. Verse is all open chords; the chorus adds Bm.

title: Jo Bhi Main
notes: Sources agree: no capo, Em/D/G/Am, with Em7, Dsus4, Dsus2 as optional colours. BPM and duration approximate.

title: Ishq Bulaava
notes: 6/8 feel (160 BPM eighth-note pulse). Sources agree on key Am, no capo, Am-G core; verse and antara voicings vary (Em/D/Bm vs Em/G/C) - simplest open shapes used. Duration approximate.

title: Kun Faya Kun
artist: A.R. Rahman, Javed Ali, Mohit Chauhan
notes: Capo 1 with C shapes confirmed by multiple sources. Section order varies between sheets; this follows the most common layout. One sheet adds a Cm at the end of the antara.

title: Shayad
notes: Capo 1, Em-scale shapes (sounds Fm) - all sources agree. The chorus line order differs between sheets; this uses the most common Em-D-C-D-Bm-C-Em shape.

title: Apna Bana Le
notes: Two sources agree on capo 2 with G-family shapes (G/C/D/Em/Am/Bm). The sounding key is stated differently across sites (A vs B); A is what capo 2 + G shapes gives. Strumming suggestions vary.

title: Satranga
notes: Key C, no capo, C/Am/F/G. A popular 'easy' capo-5 version uses G-family shapes (plus F#, B7) - same sounding key. Sheets disagree on bar order; this is the simplest.

title: Zehnaseeb
notes: Sources agree on key D, no capo, D-G-Am-C hook. Mute strings on the 2nd downstroke for a groove. One sheet adds E and B passing chords; omitted here. Listed 158 BPM elsewhere is double-time.

title: Khairiyat
techniqueFocus: E major in a minor key
notes: Original key Cm (confirmed by multiple sources); capo 3 with Am/F/G/E/Dm/C shapes avoids the Cm/A#/G# barres. F can be played as a mini barre.

title: Main Rang Sharbaton Ka
techniqueFocus: F barre high up with capo 7
notes: Sounding key G. Capo 7 with C shapes is common; the same progression without capo is G-Em-C-D. Duration approximate.

title: Tu Jaane Na
notes: Key A. No-capo A/C#m/Bm/E is used here; easier alternative is capo 2 with G/Bm/Am/D (same key). Other sheets in G or D are off-key.

title: Dil Diyan Gallan
strummingPattern: D U X U U X U
notes: Key D, no capo (D/Bm/G/A/F#m). Alternative capo-2 C-shape version gives the same key. X = palm-muted chuck.

title: O Maahi
notes: Capo 1 with C/G/F/Am/Em shapes (sounds C#) - two sources agree. One sheet lists 177 BPM, which is double-time; ~88 used. Em appears in the second verse.

title: Chaleya
notes: Key Am, no capo, ~94 BPM - sources agree. The verse uses Amadd9 on the sheet; plain Am works. F7 on the sheet simplified to F.

title: Zinda
strummingPattern: D D D U D U D D
notes: Key Em, no capo. Sources disagree on the chorus (Em-C-G-D vs Em-G-D-A); Em-C-G-D (played as power chords on the record) is the most common. Duration and BPM approximate.

title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
notes: Sources agree on key C, no capo, with C/F/G/Am(or Em)/Gm/Gm7/Dm7. The Gm (and later Cm/Fm/D# section) make it advanced; one sheet uses Em where another uses Am in the verse.

title: Pehla Nasha
notes: Key F, no capo (two sources agree). Barre-heavy: F, A#, Gm, G#. Beginners can use capo 3 with D/G/A/Bm shapes or capo 5 with C/F/G/Am shapes (same key).

title: Bekhayali
notes: Key Am, ~90 BPM, no capo - sources agree. Sheet's Am/F written here as F. A capo-5 version exists for easier shapes.

title: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
notes: Sounds D#m. Capo 1 with Dm shapes (Dm/A#/Gm/A/C/Am) vs capo 4 with Bm/Em/G/F# - both give D#m and both need barres.

title: Muskurane
notes: Key Bm, no capo: Bm/A/G/F#/Em. Easier: capo 2 with Am/G/F/E shapes (same key). Strumming suggestions vary widely.

title: Sadda Haq
strummingPattern: D D D D D D D D
notes: Key F#m with F#m/D/Bm/E (A in places) - sources agree. Played as all palm-muted downstrokes; power chords also work. BPM approximate.
